name: application-drag-handle-row
title: Drag Handle Row
description: Generic reorderable list row with a grip drag handle and a drop-indicator line showing the target position, plus an actively-dragging state with a lifted, shadowed row.
useWhen: Letting users manually reorder a list of items such as tasks, steps, or settings.
The reorder affordance should be an explicit grip handle rather than dragging the whole row.
Showing a clear drop-indicator line and a lifted, shadowed row during an active drag.
avoidWhen: The list represents media tracks in a player queue — use application-queue-list, which pairs a now-playing row with drag-to-reorder up-next tracks.
Reordering happens via up/down buttons or numeric input rather than drag-and-drop.
The list has only one or two items — reordering affordance adds no value at that size.
responsiveBehavior: Rows and the drag handle target a comfortable touch size; the drop indicator spans the row's inline width at any container size.
accessibility: Each drag handle button has an aria-label naming the item it reorders, since the grip icon alone conveys no accessible name.
The drop-indicator line is aria-hidden since its meaning is conveyed by the surrounding row content during a drag.
Provide a keyboard-operable reorder fallback (e.g., move up/down actions) when adapting this pattern, since pointer-only drag excludes keyboard users.

variants.title: Reorderable list
variants.description: Generic reorderable list with grip drag handles and a drop-indicator line at the target position.
accessibility: Each drag handle carries an aria-label naming the row it reorders.

variants.title: Reorderable list (Dark)
variants.description: Reorderable list row adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Drop indicator and handle contrast meet WCAG AA on the dark row background.

variants.title: Dragging state
variants.description: Actively-dragging state with a dimmed source row, a drop-indicator line, and a lifted, shadowed row following the pointer.
accessibility: Helper text below the list states in words what the drop indicator communicates visually.

variants.title: Dragging state (Dark)
variants.description: Actively-dragging reorderable list state adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Lifted-row shadow and dimmed source row remain distinguishable against the dark background.
